units.source_text: 我并不相信只有老师认为我是无辜的。

en.t: I did not believe that only the teacher thought I was innocent.
Rather, it was exactly the opposite.

units.source_text: 老师置所有的一切不闻不问，反而证实我的这种推测是对的。

en.t: The teacher's ignoring everything and asking no questions instead confirmed that this suspicion of mine was correct.
